content.title: Portal - Escape Into Nature App - App Store
content.text: Focus, Sleep, Relax, Sounds Free · In‑App Purchases Portal transports your mind into the world’s most beautiful natural surroundings to help you stress less, focus better and sleep more. Through immersive nature sounds, window-like visuals, smart lighting and award-winning design, it guides you into natural environments perfectly suited to deliver life-changing impacts across productivity, mental health and sleep. Combining 40 years of robust scientific evidence with groundbreaking new research, Portal taps into the transformative powers of the natural world, and puts into practice the latest evidence for how our minds and bodies respond to our surroundings. Say goodbye to unproductive days, sleepless nights and a cluttered mind, and join millions of nature-lovers escaping noise, stress and distraction in the world’s most beautiful natural environments. Apple - Editor’s Pick Apple - Mac App of the Year (finalist) 1m+ downloads LIFE CHANGING CUSTOMER STORIES [FOCUS] The student in Hawaii who needed an escape from the drone of air con, traffic noise and the stress of assignment deadlines. “It engages your mind in a way that changes how you work and focus. I honestly am not sure I would be keeping all A's if I did not have it.” [RELAXATION] The lady who was at a heightened risk of a heart attack, and turned to Portal to help her stay calm and control her erratic heartbeat in the days leading up to her pacemaker fitting. "This app has literally changed my life - and, no, I don’t usually say this kind of thing.” [SLEEP] The mother living in a war zone who turned to Portal to help both herself and her children fall asleep whilst the sound of bombs and shelling can be heard in the distance. “Thank you for adding peace to the chaos of our world.” [ADHD] The tech professional who found Portal could help him better manage his ADHD, enabling him to unlock his professional potential, and be the husband and father he’s always wanted to be. “I use the iOS version daily. It’s better than any medication, therapy or treatment for my ADHD brain! Makes the yearly subscription the bargain of my life.” ADDITIONAL USE CASES Creativity, inspiration, mindfulness, meditation, PTSD, insomnia, maternity & childbirth, baby sounds, tinnitus, pain relief KEY FEATURES: - 100+ portals to the most beautiful & peaceful corners of our planet, including Costa Rica, Iceland, St Lucia, Scotland & Slovenia - Immersive true-to-life Spatial Audio recordings - Stunning retina-quality ultra high definition motion visuals - Philips Hue, HomeKit & Nanoleaf smart lighting integration - Webby award winning design for beautiful aesthetics & experience - Sunrise wake-up alarm - Sleep timer - Simplified pomodoro focus timer - Meditation & breathing exercises - Mix Portal audio with your playlists, podcasts, audiobooks & guided meditations - Offline usage - Siri Shortcuts - Family Sharing with up to 5 others - Absolute Privacy (no 3rd party tracking, targeted ads, or personal data collection) - Custom built for Apple devices PRICING & TERMS Portal Free: access to 6 portals. No subscription or trial required. Portal Premium: unlimited access to regularly updated library of 100+ portals, smart lighting integration & dynamic spatial audio. Monthly subscription, Annual subscription (with free 7 day trial), or Lifetime (one-0ff) purchase required. Subscriptions include full access to our Mac app. OTHER NOTES Subscriptions renew automatically unless turned off in your App Store account at least 24 hours before the end of your trial or membership Dynamic (head-tracked) Spatial Audio requires compatible headphones that support head-tracking (AirPods (3rd/4th Gen), Airpods Pro, AirPods Max, Beats Fit Pro) Terms of Use: portal.app/terms Privacy Policy: portal.app/privacy Events Editors’ Choice Need to get away—or just focus? Portal immerses you in 3D audio from incredible locations around the globe. On iOS, tap for full-screen visuals (and the prettiest clock you’ve ever seen); on Mac, click to transform your desktop into gorgeous 4K video. Bonus: Pair compatible AirPods to experience it all in Spatial Audio. This app was a game changer for me. I’ve always struggled to go to sleep. I have tried music, sleeping masks, white noise, muscle relaxation, etc. This app was really helpful in transporting me to beautiful, serene locations, putting my mind at ease, and finally allowing me to sink into the depths of unconsciousness at night, It’s soundscapes are beautifully realized visually, with varied, 3D immersive sound. I discovered that some of the soundscapes, especially the barley field and the cloud rainforest, were great aids to helping me write and work without getting distracted. Overall, the app has been a great improvement to my quality of life, which I did not expect initially.I initially got the free version and was really satisfied with the included features, so I upgraded. I have to say the monetization model was really wonderful, encouraging me to support developers without making me feel like I had to pay for a good experience. Recently the app was updated with tons of new sounds from Scotland and Slovenia. It now includes a subscription model, but for the quantity and quality of content, it seems well worth it, especially because it will help the developers flesh out the app even more. On top of that, they gave everyone who had purchased the app free access to everything, which is incredibly generous! I look forward to great new content in the future. Thank you so much! Developer ResponseHi Quantumlightgamer06, thank you so much for sharing your Portal experience and not least your incredibly kind words. Knowing that Portal has helped improve the quality of your life has put the biggest smiles on our faces - it's a goal that we hoped and dreamed Portal would achieve when we first launched and remains our driving ambition going forward! Thank you for your feedback and for being one of our early paid adopters, without your trust, support and encouragement during those early days it's unlikely we would have been able to grow Portal to where we are to-date. We hope you enjoy escaping to the beautiful Slovenian Alps and the Scottish Highlands, as well as a lifetime of escapes around the world to come! Nick. As the leaves turn and the air grows crisp, we’re excited to bring you some fresh updates to complement this season of change. This release includes support for some bright new lights, compatibility with the latest Apple devices, and a helpful notification fix! *Nanoleaf Blocks Support* You can now connect Portal to Nanoleaf’s brand-new Blocks, giving you even more ways to light up your space for the ultimate immersive experience. The folks at Nanoleaf have kindly provided all Portal Premium Members with an exclusive discount. Please head to ‘Lighting Settings’ > ‘Add Connection’ in-app for more details. *Support for iPhone 16 & AirPods (4th Gen)* We’ve ensured that Portal is fully optimised for the new iPhone 16 (incl. Plus), iPhone 16 Pro (incl. Max) and AirPods (4th Gen) so you can enjoy Portal seamlessly on all the latest Apple devices. *Dynamic Island Fix* We’ve fixed an issue where the timer and alarm notifications were being partially obscured on some devices with a dynamic island. Everything is now crystal clear! As always, we’re incredibly grateful for your feedback and support. If there’s anything we can do to enhance your experience, please drop us a line at [hello@portal.app](mailto:hello@portal.app). We’d love to hear from you :) Thanks again, Andy, Alex, Nick, Stu & Tim - Team Portal.
